name: The Mountain Course at Spruce Peak
architects: Bob Cupp (2007), for the Stowe Mountain Club at Spruce Peak
boundary_name: The Mountain Course at Spruce Peak

dtm.source: Vermont Center for Geographic Information (VCGI) lidar DEM image service IMG_VCGI_LIDARDEM_SP_NOCACHE_v1 (hydro-flattened bare earth from the spring 2023 statewide QL1 lidar, 0.35 m, EPSG:32145), exported at 1 m in EPSG:32618 (bilinear) by the GitHub Actions fetch on 2026-10-31; NAVD88 m

dsm.source: VCGI lidar DSM image service IMG_VCGI_LIDARDSM_SP_NOCACHE_V1 (first-return surface, spring 2023 statewide QL1 lidar, 0.35 m, EPSG:32145), exported at 1 m in EPSG:32618 (bilinear) by the GitHub Actions fetch on 2026-10-31; CHM = DSM - DTM
dsm.label: 2023 Vermont lidar surface model

ortho.source: VCGI colour orthophoto image service IMG_VCGI_CLR2021_2025_SP_NOCACHE (0.3 m statewide orthos 2021-2025, leaf-on), exported as four JPEGs at 0.3 m in EPSG:32618 by the GitHub Actions fetch on 2026-10-31, placed by their request boxes with pipeline/intake.py ortho

world.note: bbox of the OSM boundary (way 510265958) and every golf feature (hole 13 lies just outside the boundary) in UTM 18N, 875 x 1,267 m, plus scenery, whole 256 m chunks, centred: 1,280 m east-west (202 m each side), 1,536 m north-south (134 m each side)

scorecard_source: Per hole: Stymie (stymie.golf, Stowe Mountain Club), read 2026-10-31, all five sets (Black 6,411, Blue 5,887, White 5,442, Green 4,742, Red 4,018); rows add up. Black per hole also GolfPass, 18Birdies and OpenGolfAPI (identical). Totals and ratings 18Birdies (Black 72.1/141, Blue 70.0/132; Stymie prints 73.7/151 and 71.2/146). Stroke index GolfPass/18Birdies/OpenGolfAPI (Stymie swaps 10 and 18). GolfPass's per-hole Blue row adds to 5,824 and its tee table says 6,041: not used. Unverified third-party; no club card online (private club).
attribution: Elevation, trees and orthophoto: Vermont Center for Geographic Information (2023 Vermont statewide lidar; Vermont orthoimagery)
notes: Course chat, 2026-10-31 (developer asleep, overnight calls): tees Black (the tips) and Blue (default); standing defaults otherwise (every penalty area red, OSM boundary OB, trees from lidar, fairway trees removed); wind 1-9 mph (inland New England, mountain); theme spruce_peak (its own: northern spruce-fir and hardwood forest).
